android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.description: Allows an application to read all of the contact (address) data stored on your phone. Malicious applications can use this to send your data to other people.

android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.description: Allows an application to modify the contact (address) data stored on your phone. Malicious applications can use this to erase or modify your contact data.

android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.description: Allows an application to read all of the calendar events stored on your phone. Malicious applications can use this to send your calendar events to other people.

android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.info: add or modify calendar events and send emails to guests
android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.description: Allows an application to add or change the events on your calendar, which may send emails to guests. Malicious applications can use this to erase or modify your calendar events or to send emails to guests.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.description: Allows an application to write to external storage.

android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.info: Allows an application a broad access to external storage in scoped storage
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.description: Allows an application a broad access to external storage in scoped storage. Intended to be used by few apps that need to manage files on behalf of the users.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.description: Allows an application to read from external storage.

android.permission.CAMERA.description: Allows application to take pictures and videos with the camera. This allows the application to collect images that the camera is seeing at any time.

android.permission.VIBRATE.description: Allows the application to control the vibrator.

android.permission.INTERNET.description: Allows an application to create network sockets.

android.permission.READ_SYNC_STATS.description: Allows an application to read the sync stats; e.g. the history of syncs that have occurred.

android.permission.READ_SYNC_SETTINGS.description: Allows an application to read the sync settings, such as whether sync is enabled for Contacts.

android.permission.WRITE_SYNC_SETTINGS.description: Allows an application to modify the sync settings, such as whether sync is enabled for Contacts.

android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.description: Allows an application to view the status of all networks.

android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.description: Allows an application to start itself as soon as the system has finished booting. This can make it take longer to start the phone and allow the application to slow down the overall phone by always running.

android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.description: Allows an application to prevent the phone from going to sleep.

android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.info: allows use of device-supported biometric modalities.
android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.description: Allows an app to use device supported biometric modalities.

android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.info: Allows an application to request installing packages.
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.description: Malicious applications can use this to try and trick users into installing additional malicious packages.

android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTER.description: Permission an application must hold in order to use Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS.

android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.info: allows an app to post notifications.
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.description: Allows an app to post notifications

android.permission.ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION.description: Allows an application to access any geographic locations persisted in the user's shared collection.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.info: enables regular apps to use Service.startForeground.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.description: Allows a regular application to use Service.startForeground.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.info: allows reading image files from external storage.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.description: Allows an application to read image files from external storage.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.info: allows reading video files from external storage.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.description: Allows an application to read video files from external storage.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USE.info: allows reading user-selected image or video files from external storage.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USE.description: Allows an application to read image or video files from external storage that a user has selected via the permission prompt photo picker. Apps can check this permission to verify that a user has decided to use the photo picker, instead of granting access to READ_MEDIA_IMAGES or READ_MEDIA_VIDEO . It does not prevent apps from accessing the standard photo picker manually. This permission should be requested alongside READ_MEDIA_IMAGES and/or READ_MEDIA_VIDEO , depending on which type of media is desired.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_ME.info: enables foreground services for media playback.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_ME.description: Allows a regular application to use Service.startForeground with the type "mediaPlayback".

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DA.info: permits foreground services for data synchronization.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DA.description: Allows a regular application to use Service.startForeground with the type "dataSync".

android.permission.AUTHENTICATE_ACCOUNTS.description: Allows an application to use the account authenticator capabilities of the Account Manager, including creating accounts as well as obtaining and setting their passwords.

android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.description: Allows access to the list of accounts in the Accounts Service.

android.permission.MANAGE_ACCOUNTS.description: Allows an application to perform operations like adding and removing accounts and deleting their password.

android.permission.USE_CREDENTIALS.info: use the authentication credentials of an account
android.permission.USE_CREDENTIALS.description: Allows an application to request authentication tokens.

playstore_details.title: Nextcloud
playstore_details.description:
Regain control over your data.

The Nextcloud app for Android brings your photos and files with you wherever you go!

- Connect one or multiple accounts to your private or business cloud.
- Access, work on and share documents wherever you are.
- Upload your photos and videos to your Nextcloud to save space on your phone.
- Browse photos and videos stored on your private cloud.
- Choose files to keep available even when you're offline.
- Additional features:
  - Auto-upload
  - AI Assistant
  - Protect your account with a password or Biometrics
  - Support for end-to-end encryption

New to Nextcloud? Nextcloud is a collaboration platform designed for private clouds. Host it yourself or with a company you trust and you gain a complete digital workplace with online office document collaboration, video calls and chat, email, calendar and project management, a local AI assistant and much more.

See https://nextcloud.com/hub to find out what Nextcloud can do for you!

For discussions and reporting issues please go to https://help.nextcloud.com/c/clients/android
playstore_details.summary: The Nextcloud Android app allows you to access all your files on your Nextcloud.
